podcast.body: This song perfectly encapsulated the bubblegum formula, particularly with its distinctive chant ("S-A-T-U-R-D-A-Y night!"). Recorded in 1973, it was not released in the United States until the summer of 1975, eventually hitting number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1976. The song's chant served as the inspiration for The Ramones' "Hey Ho, Let's Go" in "Blitzkrieg Bop." "Saturday night hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1976."
